paper_id: Learning to Rewrite for Non-Autoregressive Neural Machine Translation
title: Learning to Rewrite for Non-Autoregressive Neural Machine Translation
motivation: 现有迭代NAT模型依赖低效启发式规则定位错误,会误改正确词而保留错误词
problem_framing: 将翻译修正问题显式建模为 locate-revise 两阶段学习
key_insight: 通过 locator 模块显式学习区分错误词,取代基于置信度的启发式mask规则
evaluation_criteria: BLEU score、迭代次数、加速比、词重复率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: De→En 上落后JM-NAT (31.52 vs 32.24),因教师模型更强
evidence_for_taste: mask-predict may mistake to rewrite correct words
thinking_moves: 从迭代NAT的核心弱点(错误识别不准确)切入而非修补性能
把perception问题重构为communication问题:显式学习定位错误
通过迭代训练保持训练-推理数据分布一致性
承认共享权重导致性能微降但换来更少迭代
extraction_notes: Xiaocheng Feng is co-author, not first/corresponding. Email is xcfeng@ir.hit.edu.cn.
